settings.title: Settings
settings.intro.hotkeys: Global shortcuts, active even when the game has focus. “Start / pause” plays, draws or cooks depending on the open activity; “Stop everything” stops everything, everywhere.
settings.intro.draw: How DodoTopia paints in the game. Format, framing and colours are set in the Drawing activity. Configured game areas are not affected by “Reset”.
settings.intro.cook: Recognition thresholds and delays of the cooking loop. The number of dishes and stoves are set in the Cooking activity.
settings.intro.online: Discord account, shared catalogue, rooms and updates go through this server. The application works normally without it.
settings.intro.general: Theme and language of the interface. The terms of use, instrument names and song names keep their own language.
settings.general.theme.label: Theme
settings.general.theme.help: “Automatic” follows your system’s light or dark mode. Saved on this computer only.
settings.group.lecture.title: Playing in the game
settings.group.lecture.intro: How the keys are sent to Heartopia.
settings.group.multi.title: Sound sync
settings.group.multi.intro: Play together without a network: the first player plays a cue note in the game, DodoTopia hears it on the audio output and everyone starts together. Player number and lead/lag: player panel.
settings.stop_on_input.label: Take back control at any time
settings.stop_on_input.help: A key or a click while playing in the game stops it immediately.
settings.start_delay.label: Delay before playing
settings.start_delay.help: Time to get back into the game after the start shortcut.
settings.hold_mode.label: Press mode
settings.hold_mode.help: Follow the music: long presses on held notes. Tap: the same duration for all.
settings.hold_time.label: Press duration
settings.hold_time.help: Minimum time a key is held down.
settings.input_mode.label: Key sending
settings.input_mode.help: Switch to “Displayed letter” only if the played notes are wrong.
settings.min_press.label: Minimum press
settings.min_press.help: Below this duration the game doesn't see the key (one frame at 60 fps lasts 17 ms).
settings.min_gap.label: Minimum gap between two presses
settings.min_gap.help: Time between releasing and pressing the same key again.
settings.sustain.label: Sustain pedal
settings.sustain.help: Extends the notes held by the file's pedal (CC64), like on a piano.
settings.game_process.label: Game program
settings.game_process.help: Game programs, separated by commas (Heartopia runs as xdt.exe). The window titled “Heartopia” is recognised too. Playing, drawing and cooking stop if another window comes to the front. Empty = no check.
settings.multi.device.label: Audio output listened to
settings.multi.device.help: The one where the game plays its sound; the list is re-read each time the panel opens. If the chosen device was unplugged, it stays listed, marked “missing”.
settings.multi.countdown.label: Listening time before the start
settings.multi.countdown.help: Time during which DodoTopia listens to the game, waiting for the cue note.
settings.multi.lead.label: Delay after the cue note
settings.multi.lead.help: Time between the cue pattern and the start of the music.
settings.draw.verify.label: Verify and correct
settings.draw.verify.help: Re-reads the screen after each colour and repaints the missing cells.
settings.draw.mouse_glide.label: Natural mouse
settings.draw.mouse_glide.help: The cursor glides to each target instead of jumping.
settings.draw.glide_speed.label: Glide duration
settings.draw.glide_speed.help: 1 = about 0.1 s per 100 px; 2 = twice as slow.
settings.draw.dense.label: Precise mode
settings.draw.dense.help: One mouse point per cell from the start: slower, for when strokes come out dotted.
settings.draw.refine.label: Two reference cells
settings.draw.refine.help: Paints two reference cells and measures the exact cell size on screen.
settings.draw.step_delay.label: Delay between two points
settings.draw.step_delay.help: Increase it if the game cuts the corners of strokes.
settings.draw.click_delay.label: Delay after a click
settings.cook.cook_timeout.label: Maximum cooking time
settings.cook.cook_timeout.help: Beyond this, the loop stops (dish not ready).
settings.cook.match.label: Recognition threshold
settings.cook.match.help: Minimum score to recognise an icon: lower it if the bubble isn't seen, raise it if something else is mistaken for it.
settings.cook.green_px.label: Green pixels of the ring
settings.cook.green_px.help: Minimum number of green pixels to recognise the spatula's ring.
settings.cook.click_delay.label: Delay after a click
settings.cook.click_delay.help: Time given to the game after each click.
settings.online.server_url.label: Server address
settings.online.check_updates.label: Check for updates
settings.online.check_updates.help: At startup, offers the new version when there is one.
settings.online.auto_update.label: Install automatically
settings.online.auto_update.help: At startup, installs the new version and restarts DodoTopia (installed version only).
settings.hotkeys.play_pause.label: Start / pause (depending on the open activity)
settings.hotkeys.stop.label: Stop everything
settings.hotkeys.next_song.label: Next song
settings.hotkeys.prev_song.label: Previous song
settings.hotkeys.speed_down.label: Slow down
settings.hotkeys.speed_up.label: Speed up
settings.hotkeys.next_instrument.label: Next instrument
settings.hotkeys.draw_point.label: Save a position (setup)
settings.hotkeys.keycap_title: Click, then press the new key
settings.grids.label: Cells per format
settings.grids.help: Width × height at maximum detail; detected during setup if the game's grid is visible, otherwise correct it here.
settings.storage.songs.label: Songs folder
settings.storage.songs.help: Imported .mid files are copied here. Fixed location.
settings.storage.data.label: Data folder
settings.storage.data.help: Settings, library, instrument profiles and logs. Fixed location.
settings.multi.diag.title: Diagnostics
settings.multi.diag.text: Measured latency: {lat}{freqs, select, none {} other { · frequencies {freqs} Hz}}
settings.multi.diag.help: The window shrinks during the test: switch to Heartopia, instrument open. Listening reports which patterns it recognises.
settings.multi.diag.test_started: Test started: switch to Heartopia (3 s), instrument open…
settings.about.no_network: The network client is not available in this version.
settings.about.install_kind: {kind, select, setup {Installed (installer)} portable {Portable} targz {Linux archive} source {From source} other {{raw}}}
settings.about.intro: Toolbox for Heartopia: music, drawing and cooking in the game. Settings are saved as soon as they change.
settings.about.legal_1: © {year} Dodo. DodoTopia is an independent project, not affiliated in any way with the publishers of Heartopia; the trademarks mentioned belong to their owners. The application sends keys and reads the screen for you: you use it at your own risk, and automation may be against the game's terms.
settings.about.legal_2: Without an account, nothing is sent to the server apart from the update check (installed version and platform). With a Discord account: your nickname, avatar and Discord ID, plus the songs you share. Details on the Privacy page.
settings.reset.title: Reset
settings.reset_scope.lecture: Delay before playing, taking back control, press mode and key sending return to their original values. Your library and your songs are untouched.
settings.reset_scope.multi: Audio output, listening time and delay after the cue note return to their original values. The measured latency and the timing between players are kept.
settings.reset_scope.hotkeys: All shortcut keys return to their original values.
settings.reset_scope.draw: Drawing method, verification and delays return to their original values. Configured game areas and the number of cells per format are untouched.
settings.reset_scope.cook: Number of dishes and stoves, maximum time and recognition thresholds return to their original values. The game area setup and the saved icons are untouched.
settings.reset_scope.online: Server address and update options return to their original values. You stay signed in to your account.
settings.reset_scope.grids: The number of cells of each of the 5 formats returns to its original value; an automatic measurement will need to be redone.
settings.search.title: Search results
settings.search.results: {n, plural, one {# setting found} other {# settings found}}
settings.protocol.title: dodotopia:// links
settings.protocol.help: A dodotopia:// link (website, Discord) opens DodoTopia, which always asks for your confirmation before acting.
settings.arrange.label: Automatic arrangement
settings.arrange.help: Adapts the song to instruments with few keys: the melody is always kept and moved by whole phrases, chords are thinned out, and notes without a matching key are left out instead of sounding wrong. Auto: only for instruments without every sharp and flat. Each song can pick its version in “Song settings”.
settings.overlay.enabled.label: Overlay in Heartopia
settings.overlay.enabled.help: Small window in a corner of the game showing the song or drawing in progress. It only appears when Heartopia is in front and a song or drawing is running; clicks go through it and it doesn’t show up in screenshots.
settings.overlay.corner.label: Overlay position
settings.overlay.corner.help: Corner of the game window where it appears.
settings.multi.room_minimize.label: Minimize DodoTopia when a room starts
settings.multi.room_minimize.help: Off: DodoTopia stays open at the start; click on Heartopia during the countdown (that click doesn’t cancel the start).
